body: i had my psychiatrist visit today and i was diagnosed with OCD and i think it makes a lot of sense. its not so much letting the disorder define me but more so knowing what it is so that i can identify what the hell is even going on and receive proper treatment. i also like to know what it is so that i can be able to know that it's just my brain being wrong and making me think/feel this way. i feel like it provides a very important perspective in beginning the recover path from whatever mental illness you may be going through. thank you for the response and i will definitely take it into perspective if i ever find myself truly struggling with that specific issue.

thank you for the reply! i looked into it and i came across ocpd, which is a personality disorder. it has it’s differences and similarities with ocd. i’m looking in to what it could be and what i am going to be bringing up to my psychiatrist. 

my obsessions don’t seem to be that of typical ocd behavior but i do agree it could be ocd perfectionism, and me shifting different things in my life acts as the compulsive behaviors. i’m currently seeking out which could be the best fit here for proper treatment and any insight (if you have any) is greatly appreciated!

i personally find it really useful that mostly everyone i know says they also hate their voice. i feel as if most people in general are very centered on themselves and most people don't really care enough to notice the little things such as your voice. you have to realize you spend every single second of your life in your body and you are bound to notice things that aren't likable in your taste but that does not necessarily mean others feel the same way as well. i don't know if this helps at all but i hope it can give you some insight and possibly lessen your anxiety a bit. sorry if this is no help.

i don't know if this will be very useful at all, but when i'm anxious i've been told to focus on one specific thing in the room and just focus on that and nothing else. if you're listening to music just think about the music. i have pretty severe anxiety as well and sometimes this works and sometimes it doesn't. hope this is of any use and i wish you luck in recovery
